title: Cubixon Draw
description: Cubics on Draw is a 1024x hand-drawn Minecraft texture pack made entirely from scratch using Paint. It focuses on creativity and improvement, delivering a unique style despite being created by a beginner artist.
body:
![Cubixon Draw](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76602bbc51dda79bfff498acad62587ca772401f.png)Cubics on Draw is a fully hand-drawn Minecraft texture pack created entirely from scratch at a 1024x resolution, aiming to deliver a unique and highly detailed visual experience.

This project is a personal challenge, as every texture is being made from zero using simple tools like Paint. Despite having little prior experience in drawing, the goal is to improve over time and make the pack as polished and enjoyable as possible.

Cubics on Draw represents creativity, effort, and the desire to learn, bringing a fresh and original style to Minecraft through dedication and experimentation.
